reviews.title: Big scam
reviews.cons:
I had high hopes for Beatoven AI, but the results were nothing short of disappointing. The sound this software generates is very poor and lacks any kind of depth or richness you'd expect from a music composition tool in 2024. I tried several different styles and instruments, and in every case, the music came out sounding artificial and flat. The instrument sounds are overly synthetic, almost like something from outdated stock audio libraries, and the overall composition feels mechanical and uninspired.

Even worse, there’s hardly any customization available to fix these issues. You’re stuck with the same low-quality, robotic audio, and it becomes clear pretty quickly that this AI lacks the sophistication of its competitors. The tracks feel repetitive, and the transitions between sections are awkward and jarring.
reviews.overall: If you’re looking for high-quality music or any level of professional sound, I would recommend staying away from Beatoven AI. There are far better options out there that produce music with much more authenticity and control. Total waste of time and money!
